title: NTF-Elcac urges UN: Probe insurgents’ alleged killings of 98 civilians

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-Elcac) has called on the United Nations and other international human rights bodies to investigate 98 documented incidents of alleged murder and summary execution attributed to the Communist Party of the Philippines-New People’s Army-National Democratic Front (CPP-NPA-NDF). Lawyer Liza Fidelis Cañada, NTF-Elcac
